I am a founding engineer at wrrk.ai, so I notice this stuff. A customer can reach Montdor Interior Goregaon on several channels. Each one is a separate inbox, so the same person asking the same question twice is two records and nobody knows it. That is invisible until you try to work out why a deal went quiet. It is the first thing I would put right.

Worth 15 minutes? I can show it with your own numbers in it.

Wachas
Founding engineer, wrrk.ai
linkedin: I am a founding engineer at wrrk.ai. Noticed Montdor Interior Goregaon takes customers on WhatsApp, Instagram and email, with a separate inbox for each. Decorpot runs their customer side on us. Happy to send what we usually do about that, no pitch.
evidence: no CRM or shared inbox detected
